entries.reason: notification_center tenant boundary (migration 0071). The legacy inbox drain (migrateLegacyNotificationsForPrincipal, which runs on every GET /api/notifications) selected rows by student_id alone and copied each into platform_notifications under the reading principal's tenant, so one tenant's notification reached every tenant the student was bound to. notification_center now carries tenant_id/workspace_id, createSmartNotification takes the pair as a required scope, and every reader filters on it. These operations change only because each now passes the scope it had already resolved from verified context. /api/command-center/campaign moves tenantFromVerifiedContext false -> true: the admin campaign writes under the operator's own tenant (migration 0069) rather than an implicit default. That is a control strengthening; no control was weakened. Proven by src/tests/security/notification-center-cross-tenant-isolation-postgres.test.ts, which reproduces the drain leak and asserts it is closed.
